name: io.github.JigSawFr/eurodns-mcp
description: Model Context Protocol server for the EuroDNS User API — domains, DNS zones, subscriptions and SSL.

environmentVariables.name: EURODNS_APP_ID
environmentVariables.description: Application ID from the EuroDNS dashboard, under API access.

environmentVariables.name: EURODNS_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API key issued alongside the application ID. The host's public IP must also be allowlisted in the same dashboard.
